arabic_locator.text: وَقِيلَ: الْمُرَادُ بِقَوْلِهِ: ﴿وَانْحَرْ﴾ وَضْعُ الْيَدِ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى الْيُسْرَى تَحْتَ النَّحْرِ. يُرْوَى هَذَا عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، وَلَا يَصِحُّ. وَعَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ مِثْلَهُ.

semantic_units.speaker: Ali
semantic_units.statement: The interpretation places the right hand over the left beneath the upper chest.

fidelity_notes: بِقَوْلِهِ ... وَانْحَرْ introduces an interpretation of the verse, not a new direct command authored by Ali.
تَحْتَ النَّحْرِ is rendered beneath the upper chest; do not substitute a different anatomical location.
English statements here are analytical translations from Arabic, not quotations from the abridged English witness.
The scope of لا يصح is a source-critical reading, not independently established hadith grading.
